name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An AI assistant that watches your software's automated build-and-test pipeline and helps figure out why it broke, instead of an engineer manually digging through logs.
buyer: An engineering lead at a mid-size startup whose CI/CD pipeline flakes often enough that it's costing real engineer hours every week.
business_use_cases: An engineering team wires it into CI so a failed build gets an automatic root-cause summary posted to Slack instead of someone spending 30 minutes in the logs.
A DevOps consultancy offers 'CI/CD reliability as a service' to clients, using this as the diagnostic engine.
A platform engineering team uses it to reduce on-call burden for pipeline failures across dozens of internal repos.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted version with team dashboards and historical flakiness analytics as a paid SaaS tier.
Sell CI/CD reliability consulting engagements that set this up and tune it for a client's specific pipeline.

steal_this: Set this up on your own or a client's flaky CI pipeline this weekend, then pitch a paid 'CI health check' service to a few startups with Slack-heavy engineering cultures.
